The '''Bimiza Hill''' district was an area of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pesktda]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], that bordered Pesktda Port and featured stylish [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]] houses.
